arxiv-2104-12902.title: Early Human Capital Accumulation and Decentralization
arxiv-2104-12902.creator: Guy Tchuente
arxiv-2104-12902.description: Abstract Decentralization is a centerpiece in Cameroonian’s government institutions’ design. This chapter elaborates a simple hierarchy model for the analysis of the effects of power devolution. The model predicts overall positive effects of decentralization with larger effects when the local authority processes useful information on how to better allocate the resources.

arxiv-2202-11072.title: Kolmogorov equations on the space of probability measures associated to the nonlinear filtering equation: the viscosity approach
arxiv-2202-11072.creator: Mattia Martini
arxiv-2202-11072.description: Abstract . We study the backward Kolmogorov equation on the space of probability measures associated to the Kushner-Stratonovich equation of nonlinear filtering. We prove existence and uniqueness in the viscosity sense and, in particular, we provide a comparison theorem. In the context of stochastic filtering it is natural to consider measure-valued processes that satisfy stochastic differential equations.

arxiv-2405-11635.title: On ergodic properties of geodesic flows on uniform visibility manifolds without conjugate points
arxiv-2405-11635.creator: Weisheng Wu
arxiv-2405-11635.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Weisheng Wu. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive study on ergodic properties of the geodesic flow on a C ∞ C^{\infty} uniform visibility manifold M M without conjugate points. If M M is a closed surface of genus 𝔤 ≥ 2 \mathfrak{g}\geq 2 without conjugate points and with bounded asymptote, we study the geometric properties of singular geodesics and show that if all singular geodesics are closed, then there are at most finitely many isolated singular closed geodesics and finitely many generalized strips.

arxiv-2412-09191.title: RAD: Region-Aware Diffusion Models for Image Inpainting
arxiv-2412-09191.creator: Sora Kim, Sungho Suh, Minsik Lee
arxiv-2412-09191.description: Abstract Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image generation, with applications broadening across various domains. Inpainting is one such application that can benefit significantly from diffusion models. Existing methods either hijack the reverse process of a pretrained diffusion model or cast the problem into a larger framework, i.e . , conditioned generation.

arxiv-2504-07324.title: What is the price of approximation? The saddlepoint approximation to a likelihood function
arxiv-2504-07324.creator: Godrick Oketch, Rachel M. Fewster, Jesse Goodman
arxiv-2504-07324.description: Abstract The saddlepoint approximation to the likelihood, and its corresponding maximum likelihood estimate (MLE), offer an alternative estimation method when the true likelihood is intractable or computationally expensive. However, maximizing this approximate likelihood instead of the true likelihood inevitably comes at a price: a discrepancy between the MLE derived from the saddlepoint approximation and the true MLE.

arxiv-2511-21560.title: Computing Strategic Responses to Non-Linear Classifiers
arxiv-2511-21560.creator: Jack Geary, Boyan Gao, Henry Gouk
arxiv-2511-21560.description: Abstract We consider the problem of strategic classification, where the act of deploying a classifier leads to strategic behaviour that induces a distribution shift on subsequent observations. Current approaches to learning classifiers in strategic settings are focused primarily on the linear setting, but in many cases non-linear classifiers are more suitable.

pmc-10527650.title: Emerging Roles of Ubiquitination in Biomolecular Condensates
pmc-10527650.creator: Peigang Liang, Jiaqi Zhang, Bo Wang, Hengbin B Wang
pmc-10527650.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Biomolecular condensates are dynamic non-membrane-bound macromolecular high-order assemblies that participate in a growing list of cellular processes, such as transcription, the cell cycle, etc. Disturbed dynamics of biomolecular condensates are associated with many diseases, including cancer and neurodegeneration. Extensive efforts have been devoted to uncovering the molecular and biochemical grammar governing the dynamics of biomolecular condensates and establishing the critical roles of protein posttranslational modifications (PTMs) in this process.

pmc-10647521.title: Sustainable Production of Lactic Acid from Cellulose Using Au/W-ZnO Catalysts
pmc-10647521.creator: Mingyu Guo, Chengfeng Zhou, Yuandong Cui, Wei Jiang, Guangting Han, Zhan Jiang, Haoxi Ben, Xiaoli Yang, Ziying Zhang, Yanwei Huang, Shisheng Xiong
pmc-10647521.description: The catalytic conversion of cellulose to lactic acid (LA) has garnered significant attention in recent years due to the potential of cellulose as a renewable and sustainable biomass feedstock. Here, a series of Au/W-ZnO catalysts were synthesized and employed to transform cellulose into LA.

pmc-11321361.title: Parallel Evolution at the Regulatory Base-Pair Level Contributes to Mammalian Interspecific Differences in Polygenic Traits
pmc-11321361.creator: Alexander S Okamoto, Terence D Capellini, Andrey Rzhetsky
pmc-11321361.description: Parallel evolution occurs when distinct lineages with similar ancestral states converge on a new phenotype. Parallel evolution has been well documented at the organ, gene pathway, and amino acid sequence level but in theory, it can also occur at individual nucleotides within noncoding regions.

pmc-11410845.title: Size adaptation: Do you know it when you see it?
pmc-11410845.creator: Sami R Yousif, Sam Clarke
pmc-11410845.description: The visual system adapts to a wide range of visual features, from lower-level features like color and motion to higher-level features like causality and, perhaps, number. According to some, adaptation is a strictly perceptual phenomenon, such that the presence of adaptation licenses the claim that a feature is truly perceptual in nature.

pmc-11537117.title: The microbiota of moon snail egg collars is shaped by host-specific factors
pmc-11537117.creator: Karla Piedl, Frank O. Aylward, Emily Mevers
pmc-11537117.description: Moon snails (Family: Naticidae) lay eggs using a mixture of mucus and sediment to form an egg mass commonly referred to as an egg collar. These egg collars do not appear to experience micro-biofouling or predation, and this observation led us to hypothesize that the egg collars possess a chemically rich microbiota that protect the egg collars from pathogens.

pmc-11574372.title: Prévention de l’anxiété péri-opératoire: Apport de la distraction audiovisuelle
pmc-11574372.creator: Faten Haddad, Sirine Rais, Hajer Arfaoui, Emna Kammoun, Skander Naimi, M'hamed Sami Mebazaa
pmc-11574372.description: RESUMEIntroduction: La distraction audiovisuelle (DAV) constitue un des moyens non pharmacologiques de la prévention de l’anxiété. Cependant, peu d’études ont évalué son effet en périopératoire chez l’adulte. Objectif: Évaluer l'apport de la DAV dans la prévention de l'anxiété périopératoire des patients adultes proposés pour une chirurgie sous rachianesthésie.
